contract.selection: Explicit immutable version and optional run ID, matched across sanitized canvas, context and actual run evidence within one SQLite snapshot.
contract.context: Configured work-item/prepared goal and fact references, connection/target/rule references; actual retained memory handoffs, linked work, approval and machine-binding evidence remain separate.
contract.historical: No current-version fallback. Capture whether a version was locked when a new run was accepted. Mutable/ambiguous legacy history is explicitly unavailable, while retained actual steps remain readable.
contract.manual: Existing /api/workflows/:id/run accepts an explicit Brief envelope and bounded object payload; atomic run/job/receipt with maxAttempts=1; durable idempotency and read-only request recovery. Accepted receipts remain recoverable in their original scope after workflow hard deletion.
contract.read_shape: Compatible with pinned D-19/D-20 validators; graph projection is read-only and not an editor replacement.
contract.security: Exact provider/capability gate, authenticated routes, project-scoped reads, no-store JSON, bounded legacy data, conservative text/key/subtree redaction, no decrypted connections or bearer wait IDs.

activation.capability_readiness: Backend contract verified with fixtures. Production UI host integration and release verification pending.

limits.overflow: Explicit refusal for collection/source/response/request capacity; labeled omission for oversized individual fields; no receipt eviction.

verification.intermediate_failures: Fixed a missing fake-executor stepsCount type and two test fixture setup errors. One repeated run during local contention hit four default 5-second timeouts; the final 15-second focused and affected runs passed. No skipped failing assertions.
verification.hooks: Initial implementation normal hooks passed all repository guards, 162 related tests / 11173 assertions and TypeScript. Correction commit uses the same normal hooks; result reported in PR #939.
verification.ci: Reviewed head 64609e98 passed full CI: 8501 pass, 38 skip, zero fail; one unchanged browser integration needed attempt 3. New-head CI is reported separately in PR #939 after pushing the review fixes.
verification.self_review: Reviewed the complete staged diff, auth/scoping, immutable history, redaction, idempotent transaction and rollback. Added regressions for loop/literal identity collisions, malformed legacy step containers, prototype-name statuses and non-finite manual input. Addressed all four independent reviewer findings; compared the changed queries and storage normalization with the real writer and pinned consumer contracts.

limitations: All arbitrary string leaves and field names are redacted until reviewed schemas can safely expose more; numeric/boolean values, structure and typed references remain inspectable.
No immutable graph reconstruction for legacy mutable or ambiguous version history; those graphs are explicitly unavailable.
Connection identities, policy snapshots and context not captured by existing run records remain unavailable rather than inferred from configuration.
Memory reflects retained supplied/outcome-verified events, not complete lifetime coverage or proof of model reliance.
D-19/D-20 production host binding, shared durable UI command ownership and source navigation are not activated or certified here.
Six optional Q integrations were skipped because their providers are absent from this staged base. No live provider, paid model, hosted baseline, or deployment certification.
F-22 is not implemented. Shared roadmap register and private context files were not edited.
rollback: Unset the feature flag and restart. Retain idempotency receipts and version-evidence table/trigger. Do not downgrade to a build that silently treats the Brief request envelope as an unkeyed legacy start. Accepted runs continue normally; no replay or effect rollback.
evidence_policy: Only commands, verdicts and fixed metadata are committed; raw fixture output and private context are excluded.
